title: Stairway to Heaven
composer: Jimmy Page & Robert Plant / Led Zeppelin
description: The unmistakable right-hand acoustic guitar arpeggios and Robert Plant's timeless verse melody ("There's a lady who's sure").
generalTip: Key of A minor. In the intro, the right hand rolls through C-E harmony while the top voice climbs: A -> B -> C -> D.

sections.label: The Iconic Arpeggio
tips: 🪜 The legendary acoustic opening — C-E rolls under the climbing melody: A -> B -> C -> D!
👆 Beat 1: c-e-a (Finger 1, 2, 4). Beat 2: c-e-b (reach pinky to b)
🖤 ^f is F# (black key) rolling into high d': the signature Zeppelin mystery
